gloss: to question closely; to demand an explanation

definitions.gloss: to question closely; to demand an explanation; to press for the truth
definitions.explanation: To ask someone pointed questions to get at the truth of something doubtful or wrong, such as a lie, a mistake or a suspicious act. The person questioned takes に (or を when no matter is named), and the matter takes を.

examples.japanese: ⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{問|と}いただす。
⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}り→帰り：01275_kaeri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{問|と}いただされた。
examples.english: My mother demanded to know why I was home so late.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{真意|しんい}→真意：13699_shini⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{問|と}いただした。
examples.english: The reporters pressed the minister on what he had really meant by his remark.

notes:
Also written {問|と}い{質|ただ}す. ⟦{問|と}う→問う：02299_tou⟧ (to ask) + ただす (to look into, set straight).

TRANSITIVITY: Transitive. ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{問|と}いただす (person ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, matter ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧), or ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{問|と}いただす when only the person is named.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{真意|しんい}→真意：13699_shini⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{問|と}いただす: to ask what someone really meant
- ⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{問|と}いただす: to press for the facts
- ⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧{問|と}いただす: to question someone sharply

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{問|と}い{詰|つ}める→問い詰める：09147_toitsumeru⟧: to grill someone, keep asking until they have no answer; more relentless
- ⟦{追及|ついきゅう}する→追及する：21385_tsuikyuu⟧: to pursue (responsibility, a scandal); formal, used of officials and the press
